descriptionChirho: Proper noun referring to (1) the territory/people of Cush (Ethiopia/Nubia), the land south of Egypt in the upper Nile region, and (2) Cush son of Ham in the Table of Nations (Gen 10:6-8; 1 Chr 1:8-10). As a geographic/ethnic designation, appears extensively in the prophets (Isa 18:1; 20:3-5; 37:9; 43:3; 45:14; Ezek 30:4), the Psalms (Ps 68:31; 87:4), and historical narratives (2 Kgs 19:9; 2 Chr 14:9; Esth 1:1; 8:9). Also used of a Benjamite in the psalm title (Ps 7:1 concerning Cush the Benjamite). All inflectional variations with prepositions (in Cush, from Cush) and conjunctions (and Cush) are the same proper noun in different syntactic contexts.
